observations: White foreground, clock, badge and contextual copy were visually readable against the scenic and white-image fixtures.
The enlarged name wrapper stays inside the hero after its width constraints were corrected.
At320px with200% text the heart stacks above the full-width day count, and the clock moves below its divider without overflow.
Settings opens by keyboard, preserves unsaved city input when switching to Amharic, and Escape restores focus to the settings trigger.
Reduced-transparency, forced-colors and reduced-motion were exercised in both themes; solid panel fallbacks and heartbeat suppression worked.
limitations: The active Growth orb decorative ring exceeds its own clientWidth; excluded from functional overflow totals.
Only Vite development HMR WebSocket warnings occurred; no application runtime errors.
Screenshots hide fixed header/navigation only for artifact capture.
Native mobile platforms, uploaded avatar image quality, live API content, saved photo uploads and native-speaker translation review were not exercised.
